title: Sample email service not sending
lessons_learned: Check the mail queue monitor every morning

title: Sample file share slow for one office
action_taken: Moved backup window off working hours

title: Sample VPN login failures
action_taken: Reset the gateway certificate, verified logins
lessons_learned: Renew certificates two weeks before expiry

title: Sample printer queue stuck
action_taken: Cleared the stuck job, restarted the spooler

title: Sample suspicious login attempts
action_taken: Blocked the source address, forced password resets

title: Sample database backup failed
action_taken: Ran a manual backup, verified the restore
lessons_learned: Test restores monthly not just backups

title: Sample website shows error page
action_taken: Rolled back the bad update, verified the site
lessons_learned: Test updates on a staging copy first

title: Sample Wi-Fi drops in one meeting room
action_taken: Moved the access point, re-measured signal
lessons_learned: Survey coverage after any office move

title: Sample antivirus alert on one laptop
action_taken: Isolated the laptop, removed the file, rescanned
lessons_learned: Keep the isolation steps printed at the desk

title: Sample payroll app slow at month end
action_taken: Limited logins to essential users only

title: Sample phishing email reported
action_taken: Warned all users, removed the message
